title: The positive model does not assume a fitted-mode oracle
statement: Stable spectral factor and controllability Gramian yield at mostn+1 coupled oscillator modes without assumed SDP feasibility. Explicit2modeA=[[0,1],[-1,-2]],ell=(0,2),c=sqrt(alpha/(2a))*(-ia,1)/2, A+Aadj=-ell elladj, H=(i/2)(A-Aadj). H has positive/negative energies: driven synthetic simulator, not equilibrium positive-energy reservoir. Odd repeated reciprocal dyadics give explicit pole separation, confluent-Cauchy determinant/Gramian conditioning, polynomial arithmetic and guard bits in logarithmic range parameters/requested coefficient precision. Existence-level finite-bit proof, not optimized stable routine; whitening realizes a NEW canonical network, not nonunitary change of existing physical oscillators. Physical fastest coefficients still grow polynomially inT/epsilon.

requires: Explicit dimensionless Sstar(w)=alpha(|w|+w)/(1+w²)²,alpha>0; arbitrary finite-dimensional H_S(t), bounded Hermitian Q, factorized Gaussian bath and reference; prescribed-time instruments.

Vacuum canonical coupled oscillator process is defined by finite-cutoff Cauchy limit; implementable system/control operators and paid finite coefficient precision, not an experimentally unknown bath or arbitrary unbounded GKSL extension.
